caption_L1: Here a bar plot is named Ranking of largest geothermal plants worldwide as of March 2020 (in megawatts). The y-axis plots Capacity in megawatts while the x-axis measures Geothermal plant.
caption_L2L3: The geysers, in the united states, have the highest capacity in megawatts. The United states have the largest number of plants out of the country listed. The united states also produces the highest number of megawatts across all the listed countries with plants. Darajat has the lowest output.
